definition: below average in number or quantity
description: At an outdoor restaurant on an Italian street a young waiter in a white shirt and dark apron stands over a checked tablecloth and grates a large block of hard cheese onto a plate of spaghetti with tomato sauce. He keeps going, grinning, as the diner beside him leans in laughing and the cheese buries the pasta. The camera holds on the plate as the shavings pile higher and higher until the food has disappeared under a huge white cone of grated cheese that rises above the wine glasses. In the last shot he holds up the cheese block and grater beside the mountain of cheese and smiles at the camera.

de.answer: Er gibt Käse auf die Spaghetti.
de.question: Was macht der Kellner?

es.answer: Está echando queso a los espaguetis.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el camarero?

fr.answer: Il met du fromage sur les spaghettis.
